item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. You've got a full day ahead, and the plan is solid — but plans only work if you check your own thinking as you go. Watch for mind-reading and projecting onto people around you today. When something feels off, pause and ask what's actually true versus what you're assuming. Action: before you react to anything today, ask yourself — am I responding to reality, or a story?
